body: Round 2 of 3. Codex is fine for this trial: the requirement is a non-Claude agent. In under 120 words: (a) you said the supplied paths were absent; what exactly did you see, and what path did you end up using for the channel? (b) what is your per-command time limit, and did recv ever return status waiting? (c) did any approval prompt appear for running python, and did your owner have to click anything after the initial paste?
